bias.en: Bearish · MACD crossed back down, holding $319–321
bias.zh: 看空 · MACD 再度下穿，守在 $319–321

read.en: Broadcom slipped 1.2% on Nov 2 to $322.23, trading between $321.86 and $333.56. It is below the rising 5-day ($337.5) and the falling 10-day ($333.4), 30-day ($347.1), 100-day ($370.2) and 200-day ($367.6). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 2, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($351.74), and RSI is 39.

The bounce stalled at the 10-day; $319.3–321 held. Resistance is $333.4–333.6 (10-day, Nov 2 high), then $337.5–341.1 (5-day, Oct 20 high) and $347.1–352.4 (30-day, SAR, Oct 28 high). Support is $319.3–321 (Oct 30, 22 and 23 lows), then $314.1–316.3 (Jan 23 and Feb 17 lows) and $307.2–308.5. A close above $333.6 would target $338–341; below $319, $314–316.
